title:
One foundation.
Many websites.
cards: Rebuilding content tools for every client.
Customize a site. Deliver the full project.
en: Meet Themewright, a full stack content management system and website builder. Its design addresses a familiar problem: rebuilding the same content tools for every client website.
bn: Themewright একটি full stack CMS ও website builder। প্রতিটি client website-এর জন্য একই content tools বারবার তৈরির সমস্যা সমাধানের লক্ষ্য নিয়ে এর নকশা।

title:
A website.
And its control room.
cards: Manage content, design, media and your team.
TipTap rich text and reusable components.
en: The frontend uses Next.js fourteen, React eighteen, and Tailwind CSS. Visitors see server-rendered pages, while the admin dashboard manages content, media, and design, with TipTap for rich text editing.
bn: Frontend-এ Next.js 14, React 18 ও Tailwind CSS। Public server-rendered pages এবং content, media ও design পরিচালনার admin dashboard আছে। TipTap দিয়ে rich text edit করা যায়।

title:
Compose.
Preview. Publish.
cards: Business, news, video or portfolio designs.
Arrange blocks, edit styles and add media.
en: Choose a theme, arrange page blocks, and preview different screen sizes before publishing. Theme workspaces preserve each theme family's content when you switch designs.
bn: Theme বেছে blocks সাজান ও বিভিন্ন screen size-এ preview করে publish করুন। Theme বদলালে প্রতিটি theme family-এর content workspace সংরক্ষিত থাকে।

title:
Structured data.
Controlled access.
cards: Public endpoints and protected admin routes.
en: Node.js and Express expose REST APIs. Prisma connects to PostgreSQL. JWT authentication, hashed passwords, and role permissions control administrative access. The database is PostgreSQL, rather than MongoDB.
bn: Node.js ও Express REST API দেয়; Prisma দিয়ে PostgreSQL-এ data রাখা হয়। JWT, hashed passwords ও role permissions admin access নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে।

title:
From edit
to live content.
cards: Prisma writes data; cache is revalidated.
Next.js reads content through the public API.
en: An editor saves content through an authenticated request. Express checks access, and Prisma writes to the database. Next.js revalidates its cache and renders website content through the public API.
bn: Editor authenticated request দিয়ে save করেন। Express access যাচাই করে; Prisma database-এ লেখে। Next.js cache revalidate করে public API থেকে website render করে।

title:
Business sites.
Media platforms.
cards: Articles, video pages and show episodes.
Podcast series and a persistent mini-player.
en: Themes support business sites, portfolios, news portals, video libraries, and podcasts. Content formats include articles, galleries, video, and audio, with shows, playlists, and podcast series.
bn: Business site, portfolio, news portal, video library ও podcast তৈরি করা যায়। Article, gallery, video, audio, show, playlist ও podcast series আছে।

title:
Beyond
publishing.
cards: SEO, structured data, sitemaps and feeds.
Multilingual tools and optional AI translation.
en: Operations include messages, booking requests, and newsletters. SEO includes metadata, structured data, sitemaps, and feeds. Multilingual tools offer optional Claude translation with a configured API key.
bn: Messages, booking requests ও newsletter পরিচালনা করা যায়। SEO-তে metadata, structured data, sitemap ও feed আছে। API key configure করলে Claude translation ব্যবহার করা যায়।

title:
Edit with
a way back.
cards: Content backups, redirects and activity logs.
en: Revision history, trash recovery, redirects, and activity logs support maintenance. Content backups preserve records; uploaded files need a separate backup. Team roles define who can manage each area.
bn: Revision, trash restore, redirects ও logs maintenance-এ সহায়তা করে। Content backup-এর পাশাপাশি uploaded files আলাদা backup নিতে হয়। Team roles permissions নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে।

title:
Build once.
Deliver independently.
cards: Source, content snapshot and used media.
Generated Docker, PM2 and Nginx configs.
An independent project with editable source.
en: The standout feature is client export. Package the active theme, source code, content, and referenced media as a standalone project, including generated Docker, PM2, and Nginx deployment files.
bn: বিশেষ feature হলো client export। Active theme, source, content ও ব্যবহৃত media-সহ standalone project পাওয়া যায়; সঙ্গে generated Docker, PM2 ও Nginx config থাকে।

title:
Less repetition.
More ownership.
cards: A reusable foundation for client websites.
en: Themewright combines visual editing, structured publishing, and client ownership in one reusable foundation. Build different websites without rebuilding the same management system every time.
bn: Themewright reusable foundation-এ visual editing, structured publishing ও client ownership একসঙ্গে আনে। বারবার একই management system তৈরি না করে বিভিন্ন website বানানো যায়।
